data.why: the repository ships a generated droplet/emulsion micrograph used by the official step-by-step user guide to teach the full detect-correct-export workflow, with no scale bar so manual calibration is exercised too

goals: load a microscope image of roughly circular particles and run automatic circle detection
calibrate the physical scale from a detected or manually drawn scale bar, or enter microns per pixel directly
review detected circles and correct them by moving, adding, or deleting annotations
inspect summary statistics and the particle-size distribution histogram
export the corrected measurements as CSV and an annotated image for the analysis record

review.summary: This is a faithful, well-evidenced tree whose phases mirror the README and user guide's detect-calibrate-correct-inspect-export workflow, and its features are cut at the right size. Before filing it needs small fixes: correct the Reset-adjustments claim, untangle the one-of/optional mix under calibration, drop the failed undo step, and note the unobserved automatic scale-bar path.
